episodeTitle.en: Chatbots are not the final interface: OpenAI’s Head of Design on what’s next | Ian Silber
episodeTitle.zh: 聊天机器人不会是最终的界面：OpenAI 设计负责人谈下一步｜Ian Silber

guestBioOfficial.zh: Ian Silber 在 OpenAI 负责产品设计，带队做过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的使用体验。加入前，他曾在 Instagram 工作八年，也参与过新闻应用 Artifact。他关心怎样把新能力交给普通用户，而不让界面的复杂度跟着上涨。
guestBioOfficial.en: Ian leads product design at OpenAI across experiences including ChatGPT and Codex. He previously worked on Artifact and spent eight years at Instagram. A recurring concern is exposing new capabilities without making everyday use harder.

title.en: Chatbots are not the final interface: OpenAI’s Head of Design on what’s next | Ian Silber
title.zh: 聊天机器人不会是最终的界面：OpenAI 设计负责人谈下一步｜Ian Silber

summary.zh: 当设计师能自己写出可运行的原型，交付物变了，设计问题却更具体了。Ian 用 ChatGPT 和 Codex 讨论两个取舍：哪些能力值得做成单独的工具，哪些操作应该从用户眼前消失？
summary.en: Runnable prototypes change what designers can deliver. Ian uses ChatGPT and Codex to explore when a new capability needs its own tool and when switching modes simply gets in the user’s way.

insights.title: 从团队实际能做什么看岗位变化
insights.detail: Ian 看到工程师更重视设计，也看到设计师亲手完成更多工作。他关心两种能力怎样靠近，而不急着用一个产出倍数概括变化。
insights.detailEn: Engineers are taking on more design thinking, and designers can build more themselves. Ian resists reducing the change to a productivity multiplier.

insights.title: 专业模式要有走向日常体验的路径
insights.detail: 桌面应用和 Codex 为深度工作提供了空间。但要让更多人用起来，反复切换模式、调整设置都可能成为门槛。
insights.detailEn: Separate tools serve demanding workflows. At much larger scale, asking everyone to keep switching modes creates friction.
insights.titleEn: Make modes easier to leave behind

insights.title: 把职业焦虑变成一次原型实验
insights.detail: Ian 给设计师的建议很具体：换一种工具，多做一个能运行的原型。先看它怎样改变自己的工作，再判断需要补什么能力。
insights.detailEn: Try one new tool or prototype a little more. Seeing its effect on a real design task gives uncertainty somewhere concrete to go.

related.reason: 对照 Linear 的经验，看设计团队如何守住品味和细节。
related.reasonEn: Compare how Linear protects craft and design judgment.
